name: stream-dashboard
description: Cockpit desktop Windows pour OBS, Twitch, Google Calendar et télécommande LAN
author: Rastaaslan

scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:icon && npm run build && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.desktop:make: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:icon && npm run build && electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run build && npm run security:check && npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:icon
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run desktop:icon && npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts
